title: Built to pay off. Built to plug in.

lanes.label: For business leaders
lanes.title: Stop paying more for the last few feet.
lanes.body: Missed handoffs, waiting drivers, and damaged goods drain margin and loyalty. Veranda removes all three and plugs into your existing routing software.

proofs.label: of US deliveries are re-delivered
proofs.title: Complete the first attempt
proofs.body: A verified carrier opens the box even when no one is home. No missed handoff, no second trip.

proofs.label: hours a year lost to B2B detention and dwell
proofs.title: Drivers drop and go
proofs.body: No keys, codes, or apps. Hands-free or remote opening keeps every stop short.

proofs.label: avoidable dwell hours per truck, daily
proofs.title: Put trucks and assets to work
proofs.body: Secure boxes enable overnight routes, and shorter stops fit more drops per shift.

proofs.label: of consumers won't shop again after a poor delivery
proofs.title: Goods arrive intact
proofs.body: Locked, monitored boxes protect orders from theft, weather, and spoilage, with a record to prove it.

lanes.label: For operators & technology teams
lanes.title: Add intelligent access without building it.
lanes.body: Hardware, wireless, and cloud are already built and proven in the field, so your team can focus on what makes your product different.

proofs.title: Fits the stack you already run
proofs.body: REST API, SDKs, and webhooks connect access events to your dispatch, ordering, or property systems.

proofs.title: Take only what you need
proofs.body: Five swappable boards and standalone cloud services. Add one lock or sensor, or the full stack.

proofs.title: Upgrade what you sell or run
proofs.body: Give a product, locker, or door timed access and condition monitoring without redesigning it.

proofs.title: Reach places Wi-Fi can't
proofs.body: Bluetooth up close and LoRaWAN for long range, with up to a year on battery. No wiring or installer.
